# Learner Actions

## Summary
The learner's side of an enrolment: hand in work and sit quizzes. Only released modules' assignments and quizzes are offered, the same release events the cohort timeline draws, so a learner cannot submit into a module that has not opened. Both writes go through Submit Assignment and Take Quiz, and their refusals are shown as returned.

## Usage
`<LearnerActions @enrollment={{@model}} @context={{@context}} />` — Enrollment.isolated mounts it.

## Non-goals
No grading; instructors grade through Rubric Grader.
